title: WA Recovery Pro v2.0.5 — Instant Auto-Popup Updates on App Launch
changelog: 🚀 Auto-Popup Update Window: When a new version is published, the update modal pops up automatically upon opening the app
⚡ Direct GitHub Sync: Fast cache-busting version check with zero rate limits and instant release detection
🔢 Version & Build Detection: Automatically detects and notifies about both major versions and patch builds
🔘 Preserved Manual Check: 'Check for Updates' button in Settings remains available at all times
